messages:
ams: Heads-up - runtime 3.4 + SDK 3.0 rolled to canary and we're seeing a tiny class of route failures where fallback routing kicks to legacy runtime and returns mismatched embeddings for quantized models. Not widespread but reproduces on longseq traffic.

carla: I saw that too — error shows as `fallback_bind_mismatch` in the router logs. It only hits when the model selection path chooses fallback due to kernel throttling.

noah: Do we think it's a runtime->sdk contract change or router reshuffle? Quick repro: hit /v1/embeddings with model=llama-quant-v4b and artificially raise concurrency on main runtime -> fallback -> mismatch.

ams: Repro steps match. Options: (1) apply targeted pin on router policy so it doesn't fallback for quant-v4b (short-term), (2) pin SDK to 2.9 for routes using legacy binding, (3) patch router to translate payloads for fallback. I'd prefer 1+3: reduce customer impact immediately and fix translation.

deploybot: canary report: https://deploys.redwood/canary/1749001111 7: overall green, fallback_bind_mismatch observed at 1.1% of requests on canary-embeddings cohort.

carla: If we pin router policy, we risk increased latency under overload. Need thresholds and rollback criteria. Proposed safety rule: only pin for routes flagged as "stable-embeds-quant" and keep concurrency cap at 85% to avoid overload.

noah: I'll draft the router pin config and add a spike detector: if overall fallback rate >5% OR p99 token latency increase >=30% -> remove pin and revert.

ams: I'll open a lightweight patch for router translation (shim) that normalizes embeddings from fallback runtime to SDK expected shape. PR: https://git.redwood/router/pulls/906 

sre-bot: Pin request created by @ams for cohort "stable-embeds-quant" at 1749001500. Pin metadata: runtime_policy: "avoid-fallback-for-model:llama-quant-v4b", owner: "eng-platform".

carla: applied pin in staging at 1749001500. Monitoring: added smoke job to assert embedding vector length and checksum parity across main/fallback paths every 1m.

deploybot: pin applied to cohort "stable-embeds-quant" at 1749001500 by @carla. Dashboard: https://deploys.redwood/pins/1749001500

noah: shim PR merged to canary router; will run integration harness (10k requests) now. If mismatch rate drops below 0.2% for 30m we can consider rolling the router policy to prod with gradual ramp.

ams: rollout plan: staging pin applied, shim in canary, monitor 30m. If steady green, apply prod pin with 10% traffic ramp for 1 hour then 50% then 100%. Rollback triggers: fallback_bind_mismatch >2% sustained for 10m, or p99 token latency +40% vs baseline.

carla: added release-notes bullet: "Interim router policy applied to reduce fallback-induced binding mismatches for quantized embedding models; customers on long sequences may see improved stability. Full fix pending router translation patch."

ams: TL;DR - applied router pin to avoid fallback for llama-quant-v4b on stable-embeds cohort, shim patch merged to canary, prod ramp plan + rollback criteria defined. Will post updates in 30m. :rocket:
